title: Evaluating how LLM annotations represent diverse views on contentious topics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated labels to human annotations on subjective tasks (like toxicity and offensiveness) and using logistic regression to predict model-human agreement based on the human annotator's gender (man vs. non-man).
Comparing LLM-generated labels to human annotations on subjective tasks and using logistic regression to predict model-human agreement based on the human annotator's race (white vs. non-white).

Comparing LLM-generated labels to human annotations on subjective tasks and using logistic regression to predict model-human agreement based on the human annotator's educational attainment (college-educated vs. non-college-educated).
